target_customer: Oncology clinics, hospitals, pharma and research institutions that pay for patient tumor drug response testing
problem: Few cancer drugs predict well which patient will respond. Known Medicine breaks patient tumors into thousands of micro-tumors, tests drugs on them in 3D culture and applies machine learning to predict response and find biomarkers.
business_model: B2B testing services and dataset licensing for drug development and clinical decisions
product_category: Patient derived 3D cell culture and AI for oncology drug response

founders.name: Andrea Mazzocchi
founders.background_notes: Role and credential from a single profile summary; YC page lists no founder names.

founders.name: Katie-Rose Skelly
founders.background_notes: Role from a single profile summary.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs wet lab 3D culture of patient tumors at scale, imaging, and ML to predict drug response, which combines biology and software research problems.

defensibility.rationale: A growing purpose-built dataset of patient cell responses and lab process know-how are hard to copy, but organoid testing is also pursued by well funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals such as Xilis raised a 70M dollar Series A; no incumbent is shown copying Known Medicine, and the buyer of Known Medicine is not public.

market_need_then: Oncology drug failure rates are high and precision medicine funding was strong in 2020 and 2021, but sources found give no hard demand numbers.

branding.domain_note: Uses knownmed.com, an abbreviation rather than the exact name .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, tagline The Future is Known

branding.community_and_virality: Local biotech community coverage by BioUtah and Silicon Slopes; no merch or fan base found.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaningful, credible name and tagline but generic and confusable with unrelated Known-branded companies; no brand driven growth evidence.

outcome_analysis: Known Medicine raised a 7.2 million dollar seed in August 2021 led by Caffeinated Capital with Khosla and others and built a patient tumor dataset on a Salt Lake City team of about 17. The YC directory marks it Acquired but no buyer, date or price was found in any source, so the exit quality is unknown. The record cannot say whether it was a strong outcome or a soft landing.
notes: Seed 7.2M confirmed by Business Wire plus FinSMEs and Silicon Slopes. A pre-seed of about 2.3M (Kickstart, Forward VC, October 2020) appears only on aggregators and is unverified. Totals of 7.4M and 9.6M differ by source. No acquirer found despite searching. Founders come from a single profile summary (theorg style); the YC page lists none. Competitor search returned Xilis and Tempus data from 2021 or later, not dated near the 2020 batch, so the list is empty.
